## What's changed

- Fixed black video when Apple TV joins a cold Tube TV channel by preparing a complete six-segment live HLS window before serving the initial playlist.
- Accelerated creation of the initial HLS buffer, then returned the channel to real-time encoding once playback was ready.
- Kept playback near the live edge while preserving each program's native frame cadence.
- Left local-library, Discovery, Steam, and retro-player playback paths unchanged.
